title: Iraqi Civil War of 2006–2008
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Iraqi civil war (2006–2008)", at revision 1373449147, opens: "The Iraqi civil war was an armed conflict from 2006 to 2008 between various sectarian Shia and Sunni armed groups, such as the Islamic State of Iraq and the Mahdi Army, in addition to the Iraqi government alongside American-led coalition forces. In February 2006, the insurgency against the coalition and government escalated into a sectarian civil war after the bombing of Al-Askari Shrine, considered a holy site in Twelver Shi'ism. US President George W. Bush and Iraqi officials accused al-Qaeda in Iraq (AQI) of orchestrating the bombing." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q17183365, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "multi-faceted civil war in Iraq between 2006 and 2008". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
